baseline.entry_conditions: RSI crossover (bullish/bearish) + BB confirmation (price touch lower band or price above basis + RSI > RSI MA)
baseline.key_limit: RSI 50.63 at trend starts prevents BB touch conditions; no RSI crossover occurring (87.5% of missed trends); 4h BEAR regime blocks LONG entries; data format mismatch (string prices -> NaN BB) technical root cause

trend_capture_v2.strategy: TREND_CAPTURE_ENTRY (secondary path, does NOT replace BASELINE_ENTRY)
trend_capture_v2.entry_conditions_long:
ALL must be met:
  1. 4h regime BULL or STRONG_BULL
  2. 1h trend bullish (EMA 20 > EMA 50)
  3. ADX >= 20 (trend strength)
  4. close >= BB basis (upward price structure)
  5. pctB < 80 (price not excessively extended)
  6. rsi < 70 (not extreme overbought)
  7. pullback/continuation: pctB in 30-70 with rsi > 50, OR healthy continuation
trend_capture_v2.entry_conditions_short:
ALL must be met:
  1. 4h regime BEAR or STRONG_BEAR
  2. 1h trend bearish (EMA 20 < EMA 50)
  3. ADX >= 20 (trend strength)
  4. close <= BB basis (downward price structure)
  5. pctB > 20 (price not excessively extended)
  6. rsi > 30 (not extreme oversold)
  7. pullback/continuation: pctB in 30-70 with rsi < 50, OR healthy continuation
trend_capture_v2.rsi_crossover_required: NO — secondary path does not require RSI crossover
trend_capture_v2.score_system_separate: yes — trend-capture score independent of baseline minSignalScore 75
trend_capture_v2.anti_fomo_protection: built-in: reject when pctB >= 80 (LONG) / pctB <= 20 (SHORT), rsi >= 70 / rsi <= 30, chop active, regime conflicts, risk engine rejects
trend_capture_v2.order_pipeline: SAME as baseline — risk engine, position sizing, leverage limit, duplicate protection, emergency stop, TESTNET
trend_capture_v2.trend_catch_rate_potential: improves from 0/32 baseline; depends on how many trend starts meet all TREND_CAPTURE conditions
trend_capture_v2.key_advantage: enters earlier or during healthy pullback, not after massive move (anti-FOMO); participates in genuine BTC trends while preserving existing risk architecture
trend_capture_v2.key_difference_from_baseline: no RSI crossover required; uses BB basis position + ADX + regime + pullback logic; separate score threshold; does NOT require priceTouchLower/Upper conditions that baseline requires
